scope_note: Manual-review source leads only. These rows do not change coverage, acquisition, or redistribution status.
acceptance_policy: Exact title/source ownership, fetchability, checksum, attribution, rights metadata, validation markers, and regenerated coverage are required before any target status changes.

leads.title: The Pickering Manuscript
leads.rights_note: Collection record and transcription excerpt only; not an automated bulk text source.
leads.direct_source_basis: Morgan exhibition record identifies the Pickering Manuscript and supplies source-owned contextual metadata.
leads.scholarship_note: Use as manuscript corroboration; page-level Morgan records are stronger candidates for exact extraction.

leads.title: The Pickering Manuscript
leads.rights_note: Source-owned digital facsimile and contextual record; page sequence, attribution, download terms, and checksum review required.
leads.direct_source_basis: Morgan describes the manuscript as Blake's autograph fair copy of ten poems and the sole source for seven poems.
leads.scholarship_note: This is a stronger acquisition-review lead than generic search results because it has a source-owned page sequence.

leads.title: The Pickering Manuscript
leads.rights_note: Text-bearing page-level transcription for MA 2879; not sufficient alone for complete manuscript coverage.
leads.direct_source_basis: Morgan page-level record for MA 2879, pp. 16-17, includes metadata and transcription text.
leads.scholarship_note: Use as a negative-control lead for future exact-page extraction: a single page can corroborate availability without resolving the whole work.
